dct_description_sm: Throughout this project, UNEP aimed to assess the impacts of climate change on food security in the Canadian Arctic in hopes of developing responses in vulnerable regions (that could be applicable on both regional and global scales) and maintaining food security in the Canadian Arctic. The main objectives of the project were: (1) to provide a preliminary assessment of the impacts/vulnerabilities and a baseline for action; (2) to compile information for a workshop on food security; and (3) to identify actions to help communities and governments respond to the effects of climate change on food security.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Assessing the Impacts of Climate Change on Food Security in the Canadian Arctic
